collection.description: A child quietly asks whether bodies and feelings change as people get older.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: (child) quietly asks whether bodies and feelings change as people get older.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: (adult), a trusted adult, explains that puberty brings gradual changes at different times.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: (child) learns that developing earlier or later can both be ordinary.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: (child) asks a question without an audience.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: (child) decides to wait and is reassured that questions are welcome.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: (adult) says private questions are welcome even if public timing is awkward.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: (child) learns that curiosity is not something to be ashamed of.

d1.name: Outcome D1
d1.text: (child) chooses a caregiver or healer they trust.

d2.name: Outcome D2
d2.text: (child) asks for a simple explanation rather than a long lesson.
